_about: Enemies placed on the new map by hand (the bake does not touch this file), in world.json's enemySpawns shape. For now a few risen dead by the start, to test hits on. Quiet Levy narrative: named local quest zones and original optional stories. puzzles contains physical controls, clues, retry text and solutions; move mechanisms using World → Puzzles.

openingText: You came off the boat at Mossreed Landing with no coin and no work, and talked a carrier into letting you ride his grain sacks up to Thornford. A mile short of the village, a wheel comes off. Abel Hurst, the carrier, wants a word.

pois.name: Abel's Broken Cart
pois.note: A carrier's cart with a wheel off, grain sacks split in the grass. Abel Hurst, the Mossreed carrier, waits on a wheelwright.

pois.name: The West Road Milestone
pois.note: THORNFORD 200 PACES. Below it, in smaller letters: ALE NOT INCLUDED. A long-faded sword and a ring of seven stars have been cut beneath the newer village mark. Someone has kept the older carving clean.

pois.name: Thornford
pois.note: An old trading village sheltering the last watch on the western road.

pois.name: The Fallen Lantern
pois.note: A winter-work chit is pinched inside the lantern: ROOK & SONS — CONTINUANCE OF SERVICE. The worker’s date of burial precedes the chit by twenty-three years. The payment column is blank.

pois.name: Briarwood Camp
pois.note: The foresters left their axes behind. Wolves circle the old camp.

pois.name: Wolf Hollow
pois.note: Fresh pawprints turn through the briars. A narrow path rejoins the watch road to the east.

pois.name: Old Watch Ruins
pois.note: Orders nailed under the watch bell carry a rook-shaped seal. “Relief deferred pending settlement.” A watchman has scratched beneath it: WHO RELIEVES THE DEAD?

pois.name: Dawnstone Shrine
pois.note: The old charter reads: “A day’s service ends at dusk. The dead owe no labour.” New nail holes surround it. Someone hung a different notice over the limit.

pois.name: Holt Orchard
pois.note: The orchard lane forms a second way back from the old watch road.

pois.name: Willow Pond
pois.note: Willows lean over clear water. Tobin keeps his tackle beside the landing.

pois.name: Miller's Pool
pois.note: A quiet pool west of the inn. A good place to fish away an afternoon.

pois.name: Thornford Town Hall
pois.note: The winter relief contract bought three carts of grain. Alder’s signature is clear. The continuation clause below it was inserted in a different ink.

pois.name: Holt Meadow
pois.note: The boars have broken the orchard fence. A timber chit tied to a post is stamped DELAYED — STAFF REASSIGNED. Heda has added: THE PIGS ARE NOT WAITING.

pois.name: The Nameless Yard
pois.note: Three family names were scraped away, then copied onto a collection roll. Beside each is an old settled debt and the words SERVICE CONTINUES. The youngest stone simply says “a good father”.

pois.name: Mourning Hollow
pois.note: Three shuttered homes shelter beneath the black trees. Morrow still tends the apothecary.

pois.name: The Bell Crypt
pois.note: Family seals hang from the keeper’s chain beside a winter account book. One forwarding address survives: Rook & Sons, Rillbank Office. The crypt is a burial place made into a counting house.

pois.name: Widow's Mirror
pois.note: No birds drink here. Patient anglers sometimes see a second moon beneath the water.

pois.name: The Orchard Boundary
pois.note: The old stone points to a hedge north of the timber trail. Osric's new fence is three paces over the line. A faded village seal confirms Heda's claim.

pois.name: Briarjaw's Run
pois.note: Pig bristles cling to the briars. A lone wolf has been using this run to reach Holt Farm.

pois.name: The Common Water
pois.note: The regulator stands just south of Willow Lane, west of the pond. Three handles share the supply under a written agreement.

pois.name: The Four Small Bells
pois.note: Four small memorial bells stand beside a verse. The collector used the great bell; these belong to the families.

pois.name: Lantern Crossing
pois.note: First onward settlement. Recommended levels 5–10. Get relief wagons across a damaged crossing.

pois.name: Lantern Crossing worksite
pois.note: Relief consignments carry two different totals under the same collection seal. The smaller total has the driver’s original mark.

pois.name: Mossreed Landing
pois.note: Alternative onward settlement. Recommended levels 5–10. Clear the raised footpath for deliveries.

pois.name: Mossreed Landing worksite
pois.note: Relief consignments carry two different totals under the same collection seal. The smaller total has the driver’s original mark.

pois.name: Rillbank Quays
pois.note: River town. Recommended levels 10–13. A ferry manifest disagrees with the waterline.

pois.name: Rillbank Quays worksite
pois.note: A freight amendment lists living drivers among the cargo. The original tally lists grain, timber and nothing else.

pois.name: Millward
pois.note: Second river-town hub. Recommended levels 13–16. Authenticate a seal against a dated mill receipt.

pois.name: Millward worksite
pois.note: The original work notice ends service at dusk. A later strip of paper replaces that limit with until the debt is discharged.

pois.name: The agreed allocation
pois.note: The agreed shares are written plainly: Homes HALF, Work FULL, Reserve HALF. Turn each handle, then test the float.

pois.name: Reedward Cooperative
pois.note: Working marsh hamlet. Recommended levels 10–13. Reopen an ordinary drainage cut.

pois.name: Reedward Cooperative worksite
pois.note: A freight amendment lists living drivers among the cargo. The original tally lists grain, timber and nothing else.

pois.name: Pumpstead
pois.note: Raised farmstead. Recommended levels 13–16. Compare salvaged relief receipts with the cooperative’s public record.

pois.name: Pumpstead worksite
pois.note: The original work notice ends service at dusk. A later strip of paper replaces that limit with until the debt is discharged.

pois.name: Willow Ferry
pois.note: Upstream departure hub. Recommended levels 16–19. Negotiate a safe cargo load for the next crossing.

pois.name: Willow Ferry worksite
pois.note: Two surviving receipts place the same worker on separate roads at the same hour. One carries a copied signature.

pois.name: Tollhouse Rise
pois.note: Border watch post. Recommended levels 19–22. Expose duplicate collection orders.

pois.name: Tollhouse Rise worksite
pois.note: The collection seal names an underwriting house, not the local council. Follow the registration rather than blaming the nearest clerk.

pois.name: Stiltmarket
pois.note: Marsh trade hub. Recommended levels 16–19. Restore a working delivery circuit between raised homes.

pois.name: Stiltmarket worksite
pois.note: Two surviving receipts place the same worker on separate roads at the same hour. One carries a copied signature.

pois.name: Causeway Watch
pois.note: Marsh-edge outpost. Recommended levels 19–22. Survey the safe dry approaches.

pois.name: Causeway Watch worksite
pois.note: The collection seal names an underwriting house, not the local council. Follow the registration rather than blaming the nearest clerk.

pois.name: The agreed allocation
pois.note: The agreed shares are written plainly: Homes HALF, Work FULL, Reserve HALF. Turn each handle, then test the float.

pois.name: Greyroot Refuge
pois.note: Woodland refuge. Recommended levels 22–25. Read the route evidence left by missing gatherers.

pois.name: Greyroot Refuge worksite
pois.note: The oldest record treats a name as a witness, not a transferable asset. The new binding relies on reversing that meaning.

pois.name: Scribes’ Hollow
pois.note: Archive settlement. Recommended levels 25–28. Protect a surviving public copy.

pois.name: Scribes’ Hollow worksite
pois.note: A living witness can correct a false entry. The correction must accompany the original, not another copy made by the collection office.

pois.name: Brinewatch Docks
pois.note: Coastal alternative. Recommended levels 22–25. Trace records through harbor copies instead of the woodland archive.

pois.name: Brinewatch Docks worksite
pois.note: The oldest record treats a name as a witness, not a transferable asset. The new binding relies on reversing that meaning.

pois.name: Saltmere Outpost
pois.note: Outer coastal hub. Recommended levels 25–28. Check storm damage before a work crew departs.

pois.name: Saltmere Outpost worksite
pois.note: A living witness can correct a false entry. The correction must accompany the original, not another copy made by the collection office.

pois.name: Highmere Market
pois.note: Upland market town. Recommended levels 28–31. A horse inspector is afraid of the stock.

pois.name: Highmere Market worksite
pois.note: A local work order bills the workers for the machinery that binds them. The cost has been charged again after their deaths.

pois.name: Quarryend
pois.note: Quarry work settlement. Recommended levels 31–35. Retrieve tools from abandoned work shelters.

pois.name: Quarryend worksite
pois.note: Wage deductions exceed the wages paid. The same office collects a burial charge from people still standing in the queue.

pois.name: The agreed allocation
pois.note: The agreed shares are written plainly: Homes HALF, Work FULL, Reserve HALF. Turn each handle, then test the float.

pois.name: Cinder Gate
pois.note: Volcanic frontier entry. Recommended levels 28–31. Survey safe work pockets.

pois.name: Cinder Gate worksite
pois.note: A local work order bills the workers for the machinery that binds them. The cost has been charged again after their deaths.

pois.name: Ashworks
pois.note: Industrial work camp. Recommended levels 31–35. Inspect the wage and furnace records.

pois.name: Ashworks worksite
pois.note: Wage deductions exceed the wages paid. The same office collects a burial charge from people still standing in the queue.

pois.name: Windscar Redoubt
pois.note: Upper upland outpost. Recommended levels 35–38. Break a raider supply route.

pois.name: Windscar Redoubt worksite
pois.note: The overseer sends signed names to Magister Vey. The destination is a sealed mortuary store, not a payroll office.

pois.name: Heatherpass Relay
pois.note: Late frontier handover. Recommended levels 38–40. Trace the network’s onward orders.

pois.name: Heatherpass Relay worksite
pois.note: The outward pass allows a living witness to carry the originals. A collection officer has removed the line allowing the witness to leave.

pois.name: Redkiln Camp
pois.note: Inner works outpost. Recommended levels 35–38. Rescue work and safe tool recovery.

pois.name: Redkiln Camp worksite
pois.note: The overseer sends signed names to Magister Vey. The destination is a sealed mortuary store, not a payroll office.

pois.name: Ember Relay
pois.note: Volcanic exit hub. Recommended levels 38–40. Carry verified evidence to the onward guide.

pois.name: Ember Relay worksite
pois.note: The outward pass allows a living witness to carry the originals. A collection officer has removed the line allowing the witness to leave.

pois.name: The agreed allocation
pois.note: The agreed shares are written plainly: Homes HALF, Work FULL, Reserve HALF. Turn each handle, then test the float.

pois.name: Frostgate
pois.note: Snow frontier arrival. Recommended levels 40–42. Keep the outer supply road usable.

pois.name: Frostgate worksite
pois.note: The sanctuary oath and caravan covenant predate the collection contract. Both promise protection to travellers who owe nothing to the dead.

pois.name: Rimepass
pois.note: Snow relay camp. Recommended levels 42–44. Track a lost patrol’s actual route.

pois.name: Rimepass worksite
pois.note: The binding borrows a dead signatory’s authority. No living witness consented to the new demand.

pois.name: Hearthwatch
pois.note: Snow settlement. Recommended levels 44–46. Allocate scarce heat after gathering evidence.

pois.name: Hearthwatch worksite
pois.note: A forged amendment turns protection into detention. Recovering the original wording gives the defenders a lawful reason to stand down.

pois.name: Sable Well
pois.note: Desert alternative arrival. Recommended levels 40–42. Check the caravan water records.

pois.name: Sable Well worksite
pois.note: The sanctuary oath and caravan covenant predate the collection contract. Both promise protection to travellers who owe nothing to the dead.

pois.name: Whitebough Hospice
pois.note: Overlapping late-act hub. Recommended levels 45–47. Help stranded travellers without repeating the frontier introduction.

pois.name: Whitebough Hospice worksite
pois.note: A witness has preserved the testimony while helping neighbours keep their shelter. Their local needs matter as much as the inquiry.

pois.name: Last Beacon
pois.note: Final approach camp. Recommended levels 47–48. Verify the last northern evidence.

pois.name: Last Beacon worksite
pois.note: The collection route leads into a shared binding Court. Either regional approach can carry the verified evidence onward.

pois.name: Saltroad Caravanserai

pois.name: Rimewatch Gate worksite
pois.note: Original limits, corrected names and living testimony are ready. The sealed Court still holds the final binding; this staging chapter does not pretend it has already been defeated.

pois.name: Paige’s Spilled Satchel
pois.note: A waxed courier bag lies under the broken axle. The envelopes are clean. Paige used her own coat to keep the rain off them.

pois.name: The Old Well
pois.note: A sewing tin rests on the dry stone rim. Della has tied a ribbon to the handle so she can find it in the mist.

pois.name: The Crossing Brace
pois.note: Ada’s marks run straight along the timber. Two new boards and sound rope will hold the cartway. A crooked fee notice has been nailed over her measurement.

pois.name: Ada’s Cart Shed
pois.note: Wheel rims, pegged joints and a kettle kept just off the fire. Each unfinished cart carries its owner’s name.

pois.name: The Abandoned Toll Cart
pois.note: A collector’s cart stands in the trees. The driver’s original bill is wrapped around a loaf to keep it dry. The loaf has been eaten.

pois.name: The Ferry Depth Marker
pois.note: The scratched red line marks a safe trickle for the bank channel. Nessa’s instruction is plain. Keep the bank shallow and the ferry channel full.

pois.name: The Ferry Sluice
pois.note: Two handles control the shallow bank cut and the ferry channel. The boards are worn by generations of boatmen.

pois.name: The Collector’s Reed Cache
pois.note: A waterproof case has been wedged beneath the fallen willow. Several settled accounts have been copied onto a fresh list of debts.

pois.name: Lamplighter’s Rest
pois.note: A shared watch fire keeps the crossing road and ferry ridge connected. Sella’s spare blankets are folded by the kettle.

pois.name: The Miners’ Rest
pois.note: Edda has kept every shift tally, including the days the miners were told they had not worked.

pois.name: The Old Lime Cut
pois.note: A shallow quarry shelf leads toward Blackpick. The wider turns leave room to step out of a heavy swing.

pois.name: The Bailiff’s Desk
pois.note: Fresh invoices lie over old wage tallies. The same name is entered as debtor, worker and deceased.

pois.name: The Roadwardens’ Reserve
pois.note: Three small cairns mark a roadside reserve. A scratched rule reads: TAKE WHAT GETS YOU HOME. LEAVE WHAT GETS THE NEXT SOUL HOME. Beneath it is the sword-and-stars mark from the milestone.

pois.name: The Dry-Stone Cache
pois.note: The stones keep the box above the flood line. Tobin’s father wrote inside the lid: Avel did not hold the crossing alone. Ask the stones who kept the lamps. The old bell garden lies uphill, beyond the north bank.

pois.name: The Bell Garden
pois.note: FIRST WE CROSSED THE BRIDGE. THEN WE LIT THE HEARTHS. LAST WE KEPT THE WATCH. Three bells bear those names. A later carving shows Avel alone with a drawn sword; beneath it, older hands have carved seven lamps.

puzzles.name: The Common Water Regulator
puzzles.instruction: Turn the three handles, then test the flow.
puzzles.failure: The float knocks against its stop. The shares are wrong. Read the allocation board: the orchard needs a trickle, the mill needs full flow, and the pond must keep a trickle. Nothing has broken.
puzzles.resetText: All three handles close. The regulator is ready to try again.
puzzles.lockedText: Tobin tends this regulator. Ask him about “Reasonable Use” before adjusting it.
puzzles.success: The float settles in its notch. Orchard: trickle. Mill: full. Pond: trickle. Water runs evenly through the little channels.

puzzles.name: The Four Small Bells
puzzles.instruction: Read the memorial verse. Ring the life in order.
puzzles.failure: The notes jar and fall quiet. The verse begins again at home. There is no penalty; the bells can be tried again.
puzzles.resetText: The little bells fall quiet. Begin the verse again.
puzzles.lockedText: These are the family memorial bells. Sister Lyra will explain their use after the burial seals are returned.
puzzles.success: Hearth, sheaf, lantern, rest. The four notes settle into one quiet chord. The families’ names can be read without the collector’s refrain.

puzzles.failure: The float misses its mark. Read the board and try again.

puzzles.name: The Ferry Sluice
puzzles.instruction: Read the marker, turn Bank to Trickle and Ferry to Full, then test the flow.
puzzles.failure: The float rests below the red line. Keep Bank at Trickle and Ferry at Full. Nothing is broken; turn the handles and test again.
puzzles.resetText: Both handles close. You can set the flow again.
puzzles.lockedText: Nessa and Hale tend this sluice. Ask about “A Little Give and Take” first.
puzzles.success: The float settles against the red line. The shallow bank keeps a trickle and the ferry channel runs full.

puzzles.name: The Old Bells
puzzles.instruction: Read the verse on the stone.
puzzles.failure: The notes fade. Nothing is damaged. The verse begins with the crossing; try its three names in order.
puzzles.resetText: The garden falls quiet. You can begin the verse again.
puzzles.success: Bridge, hearth, watch. The casket’s latch clicks open. Seven names glow beneath Avel’s sword: ferryman, mason, cook, healer, scout, smith, watchkeeper. Avel’s own words follow: THEY HELD THE CROSSING. I CARRIED THE CHILDREN. Someone became a legend; seven others made sure there was a village left to tell it.
